. /etc/lowcost-europa/lowcost-europa.env

echo "MIGRATION_PLAN_LAST"
.venv/bin/python manage.py showmigrations catalog | tail -24
echo "DJANGO_AUDIT_END"

set -Eeuo pipefail
cd /srv/lowcost-europa
set -a
. /etc/lowcost-europa/lowcost-europa.env
set +a
export DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE=config.settings.production PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
echo "DATABASE_AUDIT_BEGIN"
.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import django
django.setup()
from datetime import timedelta
from django.db.models import Q, OuterRef, Subquery, Exists
from django.db.models.functions import Trim
from django.utils import timezone
from apps.catalog.models import Offer, OfferCandidate, OfferObservation, ProductFamily, OfferFamilyPlacement
from apps.catalog.services.public_eligibility import public_eligibility_q
now=timezone.now()
qs=Offer.objects.filter(public_eligibility_q(now))
print("OFFERS_TOTAL", Offer.objects.count())
print("OFFERS_ACTIVE", Offer.objects.filter(is_active=True).count())
print("PUBLIC_ELIGIBLE", qs.count())
print("ELIGIBLE_NO_INDIVIDUAL_ORIGIN",qs.filter(Q(ship_from_country__isnull=True)|Q(ship_from_verified_at__isnull=True)).count())
print("ELIGIBLE_ORIGIN_COUNTS",list(qs.values("ship_from_country").order_by("ship_from_country").annotate(total=__import__("django").db.models.Count("id"))))
latest=OfferObservation.objects.filter(offer_id=OuterRef("pk")).order_by("-observed_at","-pk")
price=(OfferObservation.objects.filter(offer_id=OuterRef("pk"),price__isnull=False,currency__isnull=False).annotate(clean_currency=Trim("currency")).exclude(clean_currency="").order_by("-observed_at","-pk"))
delivery=OfferObservation.objects.filter(offer_id=OuterRef("pk")).filter(Q(delivery_days__isnull=False)|Q(search_delivery_days__isnull=False))
e=qs.annotate(last_availability=Subquery(latest.values("availability")[:1]),last_observed_at=Subquery(latest.values("observed_at")[:1]),price_at=Subquery(price.values("observed_at")[:1]),has_days=Exists(delivery))
print("LATEST_AVAILABILITY_COUNTS",list(e.values("last_availability").annotate(total=__import__("django").db.models.Count("id")).order_by("last_availability")))
print("ELIGIBLE_OLD_LAST_OBSERVATION_24H",e.filter(Q(last_observed_at__lt=now-timedelta(hours=24))|Q(last_observed_at__isnull=True)).count())
print("ELIGIBLE_PRICE_UNVERIFIED_24H",e.filter(Q(price_at__lt=now-timedelta(hours=24))|Q(price_at__isnull=True)).count())
print("ELIGIBLE_WITHOUT_DELIVERY_DAYS",e.filter(has_days=False).count())
print("PENDING_TOTAL",OfferCandidate.objects.filter(status="PENDING").count())
for f in ProductFamily.objects.all().order_by("display_order","slug"):
 p=OfferCandidate.objects.filter(product_family=f,status="PENDING").count()
 public=OfferFamilyPlacement.objects.filter(product_family=f,offer__in=qs).values("offer_id").distinct().count()
 print("FAMILY",f.slug,"status="+str(f.status),"pending="+str(p),"public="+str(public),"discovery_paused="+str(p>=20 and f.status=="ACTIVE"))
print("DATABASE_AUDIT_END")
PY
